verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented control over which external tools or integrations the cubic agent may access, such as a tool allowlist or integration permission scopes. Role-based access control covers who can change subscription and settings, cubic.yaml configures review behavior, and linking Linear/Jira or related repos adds integrations. These are adjacent features, not agent tool-access governance.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can control which external tools and integrations the agent is allowed to access
